input.title: Women's Octopus – Eight Arms, Zero Hugs Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This octopus zip up hoodie is for the woman with eight arms and no patience for a hug, zipped on for the aquarium trip and the long walk past anyone with open arms.

A coral octopus with half-closed, flat-stare eyes sits among rising bubbles with its curled arms and cream suckers tucked in front of it, in coral, teal, navy and cream with a worn print texture. EIGHT ARMS, runs above it and ZERO HUGS below in heavy slab capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: light coral and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small ZERO over HUGS. wordmark in the same heavy slab capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word NO is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest ZERO HUGS. wordmark and left-cuff NO, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Eight Arms, Zero Hugs zip hoodie fit?
The Eight Arms, Zero Hugs octopus zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this octopus hoodie warm enough for cool aquarium halls?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool aquarium halls, beach evenings and the walk past a hug line well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, EIGHT ARMS, above the art and ZERO HUGS below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small ZERO over HUGS. wordmark in the same heavy slab capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and NO is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The ZERO HUGS. wordmark on the chest and the NO cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for an ocean lover, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who loves the sea and keeps her personal space. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
